messages.author: ee4060ab2f9e213a
messages.subject: D5 MRDS
parts:
I have two questions about a independent observer (IO) configuration, =
assuming point independence (PI?) in the MRDS engine.

=20

Would it be wrong to include a covariate in the DS model g.(y; theta) =
that describe which observer saw the object (the capture history from =
the MR-data) or a covariate describing duplicate/non duplicate?=20

Since this is (partly) the MR-data my concern is that the two =
likelihoods should be optimized simultaneously and not independently as =
done by the MRDS engine.=20

=20

The manual specify that the covariate for a given object must be =
identical for the two observers. If you suspect differences between the =
two observers would it be possible to include observer as a covariate in =
the MR model p1|2(y; beta)?=20

=20

(I refer to observer as platform rather than a physical person.)

=20
